chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Twin Tides, choosing Spend 6 Charge: gain 12 Block, then played All Streams Flow to the Sea on Nibbit. This used both energy, left 2 Charge, gave 12 Block against the telegraphed 12 Attack, and dealt 9 damage.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Gyorin Formation alone. It would cost 2 energy, give 10 Block now and 6 Block at the start of next turn, and preserve all 8 Charge, but it would deal no damage and still take 2 damage from the 12 Attack.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up Gyorin Formation's 6 Block at the start of next turn and the 6 Charge that Twin Tides' charge option spends. It also gave up the no-Block 15 damage line from Water's Edge plus All Streams Flow to the Sea, and the lower-Block Charge-preserving Twin Tides option.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. If the intent were 5 or less, I would take Twin Tides' Gain 5 Block option with All Streams Flow to the Sea to preserve Charge. If the intent were a non-attack, I would likely play Water's Edge and All Streams Flow to the Sea for 15 damage instead of spending Charge for Block.
